the_can_opener.after: The voice comes from your computer: your trusty AI assistant and friend, Asher.
the_can_opener.alt: A garage workbench filled with tools, salvaged parts, a backpack, and Asher’s computer.

the_can_opener.after: The bot spins around, confused, and the cabinet door on its belly flaps open. A screwdriver falls out. Then a tape measure. Then a very old sandwich. That’s when you see your opening: a panel on its back, right between the shoulders.
the_can_opener.alt: A moldy sandwich falls from the Construction Bot’s open tool cabinet with a PLOP.

the_can_opener.after: You stand there with an empty wrist brace and your hair sticking straight up.
the_can_opener.alt: A rock launcher is stuck backward in the wall; a gloved wrist has an empty brace.

the_can_opener.after: The rock smashes into the front left wheel, and it pops right off its axle. The Load-Bot tips forward, spins in a slow, sad circle, and crashes onto its face with a BOOM that sets off a car alarm.
the_can_opener.alt: The smiling Load-Bot loses a wheel beside the market, with a THWOOM.

the_can_opener.after: The stick skids off the light in a shower of sparks. The shield flickers, but it holds! The bot hits it again, and again, and you push forward behind the shield one step at a time. But you can’t get around it, and you can’t exactly fight with a shield and a thumb.
the_can_opener.alt: A gloved thumb holds a loose shield emitter in place as a Security Bot strikes the blue shield.

the_can_opener.after: “Welcome to the team, Asher Portable.”
the_can_opener.alt: Asher Portable: goggles with a clip-on display, camera, earbud, and yellow-bulb signal booster.

the_can_opener.after: A wrench slides across the workbench and sticks to your left ankle. Then a screwdriver. Then a whole handful of bolts.
the_can_opener.alt: Magnet boots stick to the refrigerator and floor plate, with tools clinging to one ankle.

the_can_opener.after: “The Stompers.”
the_can_opener.alt: The fully covered hero bounces toward the workbench; the powered-down Can Opener lies flat on the wood.

the_can_opener.after: Clunk. Clunk. Clunk. You walk up the wall one heavy step at a time, staying in the corner where the bot can’t lean out far enough to aim at you. It knows you’re out there somewhere, so it keeps zapping the mailbox just in case.
the_can_opener.alt: The fully covered hero climbs a steel wall using magnetic boots, with the inactive wrench on their belt.

the_can_opener.after: You look out over {world_name} from the roof. The Can Opener, The Wrist Wrock-It, Shield Cover Me, Asher Portable, The Stompers…every single one of them got you up here.
the_can_opener.alt: The fully covered hero rests above the neighborhood with all their inventions and a blue-eyed Security Bot.

the_can_opener.after: GRABS AWESOME STRUCTURES. MAKING YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD MINE! The word “MINE” has been crossed out by hand, and “BETTER” is written above it. Under that, in gold letters two feet tall: GAS. WE BLOW YOU AWAY!
the_can_opener.alt: The fenced cannery has a rooftop antenna, trucks of broken robots, and gold GAS signs.

the_can_opener.after: You catch it with two fingers. Way, WAY too close.
the_can_opener.alt: The fully covered hero uses magnetic boots beneath an awning as a surveillance drone passes.

the_can_opener.after: “Sir, there is a computer on that desk, and it is unlocked. There is a sticky note on the screen. It says ‘Password: password.’”
the_can_opener.alt: Max’s oversized office has a painting of him shaking hands with himself and a password note.

the_can_opener.after: Standing behind the stage, still as statues, are two Security Bots with steady red eyes. One of them is giving the crowd a thumbs-up.
the_can_opener.alt: Max Grabs grins on a stage with gold balloons, flying note cards, and Security Bots.

the_can_opener.after: You pop one panel. You pop the other. Pull. Pull. Both sets of eyes fade to soft blue.
the_can_opener.alt: A Load-Bot and Construction Bot are tangled in a heap, their eyes now blue.

the_can_opener.after: Every terminal goes dark at once. The Robot Improver 3 makes a sound like a very large balloon letting go, and its lights go out row by row. On the roof, the antenna stops humming.
the_can_opener.alt: The hooded hero fires a broad blue-white energy blast from the glowing tool head past Max toward the control monitors.

the_can_opener.after: You nod back, and you keep walking.
the_can_opener.alt: A child pats a peaceful robot, Mrs. Ruiz salutes, and the fully covered hero walks home.

the_can_opener.after: The wrench head shifts with a sharp mechanical click, and a crackling energy blade snaps out along the side of the head like an axe made of lightning.
the_can_opener.alt: The Can Opener in active mode: steel wrench, copper coils, a blue power core, and an energy axe blade.

the_can_opener.after: It’s a Construction Bot. It’s round and white like a giant egg on two stubby legs, with angry eyebrows over its eyes, a cabinet door on its belly where it keeps its tools, and a big hammer in one hand. Little rocket thrusters on its feet let it hop around a job site. It’s supposed to fix roads. Right now it’s un-fixing one.
the_can_opener.alt: Construction Bot diagram: belly tool cabinet, hammer hand, and rocket-powered feet.

the_can_opener.after: Right below you, a Construction Bot, the round white kind with angry eyebrows and rocket feet, swings its big hammer into a streetlight. The light topples over with a CRUNCH, and the bot starts hopping toward Mrs. Ruiz’s corner market.
the_can_opener.alt: Construction Bot diagram: belly tool cabinet, hammer hand, and rocket-powered feet.

the_can_opener.after: A Load-Bot. It’s built like three big crates stacked on top of each other, with a square head, forklift prongs for hands, and big round rolling wheels instead of feet. There’s a screen on its chest with a little progress bar that says 87%. And painted on its face is a great big smile.
the_can_opener.alt: Load-Bot diagram: job progress bar, forklift hands, and omni wheels.

the_can_opener.after: A Close Range Security Bot. Its round eyes flicker red.
the_can_opener.alt: Close Range Security Bot diagram: antenna, wrench hand, taser stick, and wheels.

the_can_opener.after: A Long Range Security Bot.
the_can_opener.alt: Long Range Security Bot diagram: long-range vision and aiming system, taser blaster, and wheeled feet.

summoned_mage.after: “I’m fine, I’m better than fine!” She scrambles up and now she’s laughing. “Do you know what the best mage in {world_name} can do right now? Light a lamp, if she’s had a good breakfast. And you just put a hole in a MOUNTAIN! The seers were right…they were really right!”
summoned_mage.alt: The cloaked hero and Elliana react to a smoking hole in the cave wall, with sunlight pouring through.

summoned_mage.after: They’ve got long striped tails and flour sacks over their heads with eye holes cut in them, except one of them cut his eye holes in the wrong spot and has to keep turning his head sideways to see you. One has a pitchfork, one has a broom, and the smallest one is holding…a soup ladle?
summoned_mage.alt: Three raccoon bandits block the bridge with a pitchfork, broom, and soup ladle while Elliana and the cloaked hero look on.

summoned_mage.after: Washing lines are strung between the houses and the clothes on them are slowly turning round and round in the air, like they got stuck halfway through washing themselves. A long line of people with buckets stretches toward the middle of town, and the street lamps keep flickering on…and off…and on.
summoned_mage.alt: Willowmere at sunset, with moss-roofed round homes, stalled floating carts, and beastfolk using ladders.

summoned_mage.after: He launches out of your lap and chases the spark all the way around the campfire, trilling at the top of his lungs, catches it, eats it, does a loop in the air, then zooms back and hovers right in front of your face waiting for another one.
summoned_mage.alt: The cloaked hero makes a tiny spark while Honey chases it around the campfire.

summoned_mage.after: Bernard comes around the counter, crouches down until his eyes are level with yours, and holds out a honey bun. It’s still warm, and it’s the best thing you’ve ever tasted, no contest.
summoned_mage.alt: Bernard, a friendly brown bear-folk baker, offers a honey bun and carries a black frying pan.

summoned_mage.after: A fox-folk girl slides out from under the cart. She’s got red fur, a big bushy tail, goggles pushed up on her forehead, a smear of grease on her nose, and a wrench in each hand.
summoned_mage.alt: Gilly, a red fox-folk mechanic with goggles and a grease smudge, holds two wrenches.

summoned_mage.after: Gordo climbs down from his tree with his mouth hanging open.
summoned_mage.alt: The cloaked hero sits among three sleeping, moss-covered tuskers as Gordo climbs down from his tree.

summoned_mage.after: It drifts right up to the glow, wraps its ribbons around the light, and drinks. You can actually see the light flow into it. For a second the creature glows a little, and whatever it was drinking from goes dark.
summoned_mage.alt: A pale, faceless syphon wraps ribbons around a street lantern and draws its light into itself.

summoned_mage.after: Syphons are rising up out of it one after another in a slow steady stream, like bubbles in a glass. There are already hundreds of them in here, hanging up near the ceiling as thick as fog.
summoned_mage.alt: A huge golden summoning circle glows below a high cavern ledge, with pale syphons rising toward the ceiling.

summoned_mage.after: “That’s Honey,” Bernard says. “You can probably guess how he got the name. He’s a puffkin, doesn’t belong to anybody, just turned up a while back and started stealing my buns.” He watches Honey settle into your hair like it’s a nest. “Looks like he belongs to you now. Puffkins can’t stay away from magic, and you’re the most magic thing he’s ever seen.”
summoned_mage.alt: Honey steals a bun atop the hero’s raised hood while Bernard, Gilly and Elliana gather at the Fancy Spoon table.

summoned_mage.after: The rock goes straight through the syphon and it bursts apart like a dandelion when you blow on it. The pale fluff hangs in the air, swirls around, and slowly pulls itself back together a good ways farther off. It gives itself a little shake, then drifts away toward the hills like nothing happened, and the others follow it.
summoned_mage.alt: A thrown rock scatters a syphon into pale dandelion-like fluff while Elliana watches the cloaked hero.

summoned_mage.after: Bernard builds a fire the regular way, with sticks. Then he pulls out the frying pan, and that’s the end of anybody worrying about anything for a while. Honey eats four pancakes and then sits in the pan.
summoned_mage.alt: Bernard, Gilly, Elliana and the cloaked hero share a campfire while tiny Honey sits in a frying pan on the ground.

summoned_mage.after: It takes all three of you pulling on his arms and one very unhappy minute, and then Bernard pops through like a cork out of a bottle and lands on top of everybody. He checks the pastries first. They’re fine.
summoned_mage.alt: Gilly, Elliana and the cloaked hero help pull Bernard through a narrow crack in the rock.

summoned_mage.after: And then you see it. In the side of the biggest hill there’s a cave mouth as tall as a house, with broken stone pillars on either side.
summoned_mage.alt: A washed-out trail leads through the gray Hollow Hills to a tall cave entrance between broken pillars.

summoned_mage.after: It used to be a door. It’s a huge round slab of stone twice as tall as Bernard, carved all over with symbols in rings inside of rings, just like the drawing in Elliana’s book. And it’s cracked right down the middle, the two halves leaning apart with a gap between them wide enough to walk through. The symbols must have glowed once, but now they’re dark.
summoned_mage.alt: A huge round stone seal with concentric carvings leans apart along a crumbly central crack.
